Main function.description: The program's entry point. Every ProLang program needs one.

Function with no return.description: Declare a function that returns nothing

Struct.description: Declare a struct. Structs are value types: passing one passes a copy.

Variable Declaration.description: Declare a variable with an explicit type

Variable Declaration (inferred).description: Declare a variable with an inferred type

If-Elif-Else.description: An if/elif/else chain, which is how ProLang expresses a multi-way branch

For Loop.description: For loop. The bounds are inclusive at both ends.

Import.description: Import a library module or a built-in module

Import IO.description: Bring print() and readInput() into scope

Import .NET namespace.description: Make the public types of a .NET namespace available

Import .NET assembly.description: Reference a .NET assembly by name, .dll path or .csproj path

Print.description: Print a value and a newline

Array Declaration.description: Declare an array from a literal

Array of a fixed size.description: Allocate a fixed-length array, every element zeroed

Assertion.description: Fail the program with a message if the condition is false. Needs import "test".

Frame timer.description: Measure an interval. Always subtract two readings — the clock wraps.
